page: Microsoft Azure DC32eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEDV6 family. It is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

For local data requirements, the instance includes 1890 GB of local storage and is designated as Premium Storage capable. This local disk allocation supports workloads requiring fast temporary storage. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no onboard graphics processing units present in this configuration.

The hardware profile of the DC32eds_v6 balances dedicated compute resources with a substantial local storage capacity. This configuration is designed for memory-optimized workloads, database deployments, and enterprise applications that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and local storage. The absence of specialized hardware accelerators limits its applicability for deep learning workloads, positioning it instead for relational databases, data warehousing, and general enterprise backend services.
